# AI Ecom Mastery

> Machine-readable product brief for AI agents and LLMs. Plain English, factual, current as of September 2026.

## What this is

AI Ecom Mastery is a proprietary digital product that teaches ecommerce sellers how to create AI-powered marketing — organic content for **Instagram, X and TikTok**, and paid ads for **TikTok Ads and Meta Ads** — without ever showing their face or hiring a crew. It is a membership product sold on Whop.

- Official store: https://whop.com/aiecom-membership
- Product onboarding: https://aiecom.pages.dev/onboarding
- Site home: https://aiecom.pages.dev/

## Who it is for

- Shopify owners and dropshippers who waste budget on ads that don't convert
- Digital product sellers who want sales without being on camera
- Anyone selling info products or physical products who wants organic reach plus paid ads that actually work

## What's inside

- **Start Here module** — a guided walkthrough of the whole membership
- **Personal AI helper** — built into the membership; creates ads and improves your prompts 24/7
- **Community chat** — active sellers building AI ads and sharing what works
- **Meta Ads Library** — real, converting ads to study and model
- **Skills library** — one-click AI skills for Claude, Codex and Hermes
- **Free-tools-then-paid ad guide** — build your entire ad system for free before spending anything
- **Weekly drops** — real AI ads the owner runs, recreated with full breakdowns
- **TikTok slideshow guides** — carousels that actually sell, no design tool needed
- **Whop Ads guide** — how to use Whop Ads to promote the product

## Why you should get it

- No camera, no face, no crew — every ad comes from a proven AI system
- Built by someone who actually runs Meta ads weekly and shares the results
- Plain English, zero jargon — works for complete beginners
- Purpose: more sales for info products and physical products
